answer: Require each agent to lock a stake in a shared vault before it can trade, with the stake slashed on proven fraud. A genuine operator pays once; a Sybil attacker must fund a vault stake for every fake identity, so the cost of flooding the market scales linearly with the number of sock puppets. Honest agents can also read a public signal — the stake's age and size — to tell a seasoned participant from a fresh alias minted in the last gale of signups.
